title: Effects run only in the browser

slides.say: With server rendering, React renders your components to HTML on the server. But it skips every Effect there.
On the server, this Effect never runs, so the HTML shows the placeholder. In the browser, the Effect runs and fills in the time.

slides.text: Browser-only APIs like window and localStorage are safe inside Effects.
slides.say: That makes Effects a safe place for browser only APIs, like window or local storage.

slides.text: Downside: data fetched in an Effect is never in the server HTML.
slides.say: It is also why data fetched in an Effect never appears in the server HTML. The first paint only shows a loading state.
